openItems.title: JWW save/write
openItems.detail: Gateway is read/import only. Editing results are exported as JWW Gateway JSON and do not update the source JWW file.
openItems.evidence: capabilities.jwwWrite is fixed to false and verify:handoff checks that the read-only contract is explicit.
openItems.nextAction: Keep JWW write disabled until a separate writer format and round-trip test suite exist.
